reading.title: Daily Routines 1: A Weekday and Weekend Routine
reading.text: When the alarm clock rings, Rami wakes up and gets out of bed. He stretches, brushes his teeth and washes his face. He takes a shower, gets dressed, eats breakfast and packs his bag. He commutes to the office and arrives before nine to start work. That evening, he attends class and takes notes.
reading.imageBrief: Clothed adult morning preparation with closed work bag, bread and cup on table. No bathroom actions at the breakfast table, readable text or precise clock requirement.

exercises.prompt:
An alarm clock rings. Hana stops sleeping and wakes up, then gets out of bed.
Which phrase means to stop sleeping?

Before work Hana extends her arms to stretch. She will brush her teeth and wash her face next.
Which verb describes extending her arms?

Omar washes under water from a shower: he takes a shower. He gets dressed and eats breakfast afterwards.
Which phrase names washing under the shower water?

Hana puts her notebook and lunch in her bag to pack it. Then she will commute to work and arrive at the office.
Which activity describes putting needed items in the bag?

Hana begins her job tasks to start work. This evening she will attend class and take notes.

Read the passage: When the alarm clock rings, Rami wakes up and gets out of bed. He stretches, brushes his teeth and washes his face. He takes a shower, gets dressed, eats breakfast and packs his bag. He commutes to the office and arrives before nine to start work. That evening, he attends class and takes notes.
Where does Rami commute to?
Say that you commute to work by bus.
exercises.answer: I commute to work by bus.

exercises.prompt: You need the important points from a class. Say that you will take notes.
exercises.answer: I will take notes during class.
